title: BBC Learning English from the News 2025 — Quiz 15
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q141_double_down
elements.title: After the proposal was criticised, the director chose to ___ on it and defended it more strongly.

elements.name: q142_tit_for_tat
elements.title: Each side answered the other's new restriction with one of its own in a ___ exchange.

elements.name: q143_follow_through_on
elements.title: Which construction correctly completes the promise? “We will follow through ___ our commitment to publish the results.”

elements.name: q144_bearing_fruit
elements.title: The training is finally ___: the team is making fewer mistakes.

elements.name: q145_freaking_out
elements.title: In “I was freaking out when I couldn't find my passport”, how did the speaker feel?
choices: They were calmly making a plan.

elements.name: q146_spook
elements.title: A sudden bang can ___ a horse and make it bolt.

elements.name: q147_shake_up
elements.title: The arrival of a new director led to a ___, with teams reorganised and roles changed.

elements.name: q148_golden_age
elements.title: The period is remembered as a ___ of local theatre, when audiences and productions thrived.

elements.name: q149_grant_clemency
elements.title: The petition asked the authorities to ___ and reduce the prisoner's punishment.

elements.name: q150_frenemy
elements.title: A ___ may act like a friend while also competing with you or undermining you.
